in_sanskrit.name: रूपश्री
in_sanskrit.meaning: रूप (Roop) - form, shape, beauty, appearance, and श्री (Shree) - wealth, prosperity, fortune, abundance, and auspiciousness.
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is adorned with beautiful forms, shapes, and appearances, and is blessed with wealth, prosperity, fortune, and abundance.

in_hindi.name: रूपश्री
in_hindi.meaning: रूप (Roop) - रूपण (Roopan) - to adorn, to decorate, and श्री (Shree) - धन (Dhan) - wealth, सुख (Sukh) - happiness, and शान्ति (Shanti) - peace.
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who is adorned with beautiful forms, shapes, and appearances, and is blessed with wealth, happiness, and peace.

in_tamil.name: ருபச்சிரீ
in_tamil.meaning: ருபம் (Rubam) - wealth, சிறப்பு (Cherppu) - beauty, and ஷ்ரீ (Shree) - prosperity.
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who is adorned with wealth and beauty, and is blessed with prosperity.

in_telugu.name: రూపశ్రీ
in_telugu.meaning: రూపము (Roopamu) - form, shape, and శ్రీ (Shree) - wealth, prosperity, and abundance.
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who is adorned with beautiful forms and shapes, and is blessed with wealth, prosperity, and abundance.

in_marathi.name: Rupashree
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rupashree हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Golden Vision of Prosperity and Beauty

in_bengali.name: Rupashree
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Golden Vision
in_bengali.long_meaning: Rupashree একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Golden Vision of Prosperity and Beauty
